verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS that ships SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a way to disable BugSnag's own telemetry or usage tracking. The related items cover other things: retroactive redaction of sensitive data in error payloads, self-hosted on-premise deployment, and event-quota controls. None of these is an opt-out from vendor telemetry.
